items.headline: Scheduled Prompts - By scheduling prompts Copilot can run questions automatically on a daily weekly or monthly cadence
items.summary: Microsoft 365 Copilot now supports scheduled prompts that run automatically on daily, weekly, or monthly intervals and surface results when needed. Users define the question once and Copilot executes it on cadence without manual intervention. This feature is part of the June 2026 update alongside Copilot Cowork which became generally available worldwide in July 2026.

items.headline: U.S. Companies Face EU AI Acts Possible August 2026 Compliance Deadline
items.summary: On August 2 2026 the EU AI Act becomes enforceable across the European Union with fines up to 35 million euros or 7 percent of global annual turnover for high-risk AI systems. Three enforcement mechanisms activate including transparency obligations under Article 50 requiring disclosure of AI interactions and deepfake identification plus authority to fine general-purpose AI model providers up to 15 million euros or 3 percent of global revenue. The Act's extraterritorial reach means any organization placing AI systems on the EU market or using them in the EU is subject to its provisions regardless of location.
